SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-10-2024 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LOPEZ, MERCEDES SAENS IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GONZALEZ, GLORIA THE EVIDENCE SHOWED DEFENDANT WAS NOT THE MASTER TENANT. DAVID RIVERIA'S RENT IS PAID TO HIM, AND DEFENDANT SENT HIM PLAINTIFF'S SECURITY DEPOSIT. BECAUSE DEFENDANT IS NOT THE MASTER TENANT AND IS NOT IN POSSESSION OF THE SECURITY DEPOSIT, THE DEFENDANT IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DAMAGES.
